remarks:
Charming Colonial home in the desirable Amherst area!  Welcome to 51 Sudbury Ln, featuring classic curb appeal, mature landscaping, and a welcoming front yard.  This well-maintained home offers spacious rooms, abundant natural light, and a comfortable layout ideal for everyday living. The warm entryway with hardwood floors leads into a bright, inviting living room and an elegant formal dining room, perfect for family gatherings and holiday hosting.
The generously sized bedrooms provide plenty of space for relaxation and storage.  A full basement offers excellent additional space for storage, hobbies, or future finishing possibilities.  Enjoy year-round comfort with central air conditioning, while the attached two-car garage provides convenient parking and additional storage.  Step outside onto the expansive rear wooden deck overlooking a deep, fully usable backyard. Ideally located close to shopping, dining, parks, University at Buffalo (UB North Campus) and major roadways, quick access to I-290, this home combines classic charm with everyday convenience.  A wonderful opportunity to own a spacious home in the Amherst area!
